definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes throw a heavy disc as far as possible.

examples.japanese: {円盤投|えんばんな}げに{挑戦|ちょうせん}する。
{円盤投|えんばんな}げは{回転|かいてん}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: In discus throw, spinning technique is important.

examples.japanese: {円盤投|えんばんな}げで{自己|じこ}ベストを{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: I set a personal best in discus throw.

notes:
{円盤投|えんばんな}げ is a track and field throwing event where athletes throw a disc-shaped object. The discus weighs 2 kg for men and 1 kg for women.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円盤投|えんばんな}げの{選手|せんしゅ} (discus thrower)
- {円盤|えんばん}を{投|な}げる (to throw the discus)

ETYMOLOGY:
Discus throw has ancient Greek origins and was part of the original Olympic Games. The famous sculpture "Discobolus" depicts a discus thrower.

RELATED EVENTS:
- {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ (shot put)
- やり{投|な}げ (javelin throw)
